body.overview: A leader wakes to a new world.
body.title: Troy

body.overview: Maeve and Conrad go to the dogs, leaving Harry to deal with the messy fallout. Jan makes a startling confession. Kevin and Seraphina both look to the future. Tattersall puts his cards on the table.
body.title: I Wanna Be Your Dog

body.overview: On Amy and Sonya's first day as Co-Chief Resident, they must coach a fresh crop of interns through a mysterious case that seems to defy medical logic. Jake and TJ adjust to new roles within the hospital. Meanwhile, Dr. Ben Grant returns to Westside with a secret plan to reshape the Surgical Department.
body.title: Wherefore Art Thou

body.overview: With Conrad's self-control slipping, Maeve make plans of her own while Jan hits Harry with a hard truth. Smelling blood, Frankie and Tattersall circle like sharks.
body.title: Song 2
